sentences.text:
2025
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C.V.Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.14921 of 2025
Order:

This Writ Petition, under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, is filed seeking the following relief:
"....to issue a Writ of Mandamus or any other appropriate Writ order or direction declaring the impugned action of the Respondents particularly Respondents 3 to 6 in trying to dispossess the Petitioner from her lands in respect of Ac.5.32 Guntas in Sy.No.119/E/4 and an extent Ac.2.05 Guntas in Sy.No.120/A/A of Polepalli Revenue Village without any notice or providing personal hearing as also changing the name of the Pattadar as Irrigation Shikam without notice or reason and also not considering the representations dated 30.01.2025, 05.03.2025 and 12.03.2025 without following due process of law as illegal arbitrary and violative of principles of natural justice etc and consequently direct the Respondents not to dispossess the Petitioner or take any other coercive steps without proper notice and enquiry and providing personal hearing as also to consider the Representations dated 30.01.2025,
05.03.2025 and 12.03.2025 and grant....."

2. It is stated that the petitioner is the absolute owner and possessor of the land to an extent of Acs.5.32 guntas in Sy.No.119/E/4 and an extend of Acs.2.05 guntas in Sy.No.120/A/A, situated at Polepalli Village, Khammam Rural Mandal, having purchased the same through registered sale deed.

The revenue authorities also issued pattadar passbook vide No.T26060110350 and Khatha No.86 under the provisions of the Telangana Rights in Land and Pattadar Passbooks Act, 2020 and he is also receiving Rythu Bandhu for the said land.

entities.text: Telangana Rights in Land and Pattadar Passbooks Act, 2020
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is further stated that when respondent Nos.5 and 6 without any intimation and without issuing any notice, started interfering with the subject land for undertaking the work of "Khammam Munneru Check- Dam/Karakatta" and when it caused huge damages and loss to their livelihood, the petitioner was constrained to submit representations dated 30.01.2025, 05.03.2025 and 12.03.2025 to the respondent authorities to stop the work of Check Dam.
The grievance of the petitioner is that even after receiving the said representations, the respondent authorities have not acted upon the same.

3. Considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties and with their consent,
this writ petition is being disposed of at the admission stage.
4.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue appearing for the respondents on instructions would submit that the Government has acquired the lands for laying approach track for sand quarries at Munneru river in the limits of Polepalli vilalge on the requisition made by the Executive Engineer, NS Canals Division, Tekulapalli on 06.12.1968.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Acquisition Unit No.1, Tekulapalli after following due procedure, passed Award No.9 of 1969, dated 17.12.1969 and paid land compensation to the land owners.

From the award, it is evident that an extent of Acs.7.25 guntas in Sy.No.119/E/4 and Acs.2.05 guntas in Sy.No.120, situated at Polepalli revenue village was acquired and compensation was paid to the land owners.

5. Be that as it may, since it is the case of the petitioner that he has purchased the property long back, under the registered sale deed and pattadar passbooks were also issued in his favour, this Court deems it appropriate to dispose of the writ petition directing the respondent authorities to conduct detailed enquiry duly taking note of the Award No.9 of 1969, dated 17.12.1969 and if the land claimed by the petitioner is not part of the Award and if the petitioner's land is in any manner effected, the respondents are directed to follow the due procedure for awarding compensation in respect of the said land, in accordance with law.
6. With the above observations, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
As a sequel, the miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.

JUSTICE C.V.BHASKAR REDDY 10.06.2025 VSU Vusirikapalli Shantha vs The State Of Telangana on 10 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59253238/
